# social-cleaner

> Open-source, local-first CLI and Python SDK (Python 3.10+) to inspect and clean your own social-media accounts: Bilibili through the official web API, X / Twitter through Playwright browser automation. Append-only audit log for every deletion, rate limiting, exponential backoff, and cooperative cancellation. MIT. No hosted service, no telemetry.

Repository: https://github.com/qilaidev/social-cleaner

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, install, quick start, safety model
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should drive the tool
- [docs/bilibili.md](docs/bilibili.md): Bilibili commands, workflow, limits
- [docs/x.md](docs/x.md): X commands, headless policy, reviewed unfollow, exit codes, selectors
- [docs/adding-a-platform.md](docs/adding-a-platform.md): contract for new platforms

## Facts

- Install: `pip install social-cleaner` (`playwright install chromium` for X)
- Entry point: `social-cleaner bilibili …`, `social-cleaner x …`
- Data dir: `~/.social-cleaner` (credentials, browser profile, exports, run summaries, `audit.jsonl`)
- Bilibili: 1.5 req/s shared bucket; retries `-352`/`-799`/`-509`/412/429; no batch unfollow; no own-comments API
- X: only the logged-in user's own posts are deleted; unfollowing is export → classify → human approval → execute; HTTP 429 ⇒ exit code 75, wait, do not re-login
- Not for: other people's accounts, evading enforcement, bulk engagement
